appDescription: Archives the user's drives as journeys from vehicle signals and lets the user save moments and set the type of each drive.

function.name: SAVE_JOURNEY_MOMENT
function.description: Save a short note about the current moment to the user's ongoing or most recent drive.

note.description: The note the user wants to remember about this moment.

function.name: SET_TRIP_CATEGORY
function.description: Set the type of the current or most recent drive.

function.name: SHOW_TODAY_JOURNEY
function.description: Open the summary of today's journey in the app.
